'''Orinda''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Irishi sector/Legends|Irishi sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]'s [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].  It was located along the [[Entralla Route/Legends|Entralla Route]]. Orinda was on the border of the Mid Rim and the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==History==
{{Quote|The New Republic pushed Pellaeon back, but suffered a grave defeat in the Battle of Orinda. There, the ''Reaper'' destroyed most of Antilles's starfighters by annihilating the ﬂeet carrier ''Endurance''. The New Republic chose to leave Orinda in imperial hands, and instead fortified the surrounding systems.|[[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]]|<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>}}
After the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], Orinda was part of [[Imperial Space]] until [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]]. Following the [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|loss of Coruscant]] and [[Ysanne Isard]]'s retreat to [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]], [[Ars Dangor/Legends|Ars Dangor]] and the [[Imperial Ruling Council/Legends|Imperial Ruling Council]] went into [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exile]] on Orinda.<ref name="EGW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

The planet was conquered by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in the immediate aftermath of the [[Thrawn campaign]]. After that, Orinda became a strategic world because it was located on an important [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] and on the border of Imperial and New Republic spaces.<ref name="TEA" />

Orinda was [[Battle of Orinda (10 ABY)|re-captured]] by [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Ardus Kaine]] and [[Pentastar Alignment]] forces in the [[pre–Shadow Hand campaign]], the Reborn Emperor [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] campaign to reconquer the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], but lost Orinda again during the collapse of [[Carnor Jax]]'s [[Crimson Empire]].<ref name="TEA" />

[[File:LusankyavsReaper-EGW.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The ''Reaper'' faces off against the ''Lusankya'' at Orinda.]]

Orinda was [[Raid on Orinda|retaken]] by [[Fleet Admiral/Legends|Fleet Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] in [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], and defended during a great [[Battle of Orinda|battle]] including two [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnoughts]].<ref name="TEA" /> After the victory, the planet became the temporary headquarters of Admiral Pellaeon.<ref name="ce3.2">''[[Star Wars: Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost]]''</ref> The New Republic chose to leave Orinda in Imperial hands and instead fortified surrounding [[Star system/Legends|systems]].<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> The same year, Imperial forces gathered on Orinda in preparation of the Imperial invasion of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].<ref name="Nightsaber">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20031120nightsaber|text=Nightsaber|int=Nightsaber}}</ref> Orinda was later the site of a [[Battle of Orinda (13 ABY)|battle]] between the Remnant and the [[Restored Empire]] faction.<ref name="ce3.2" /> The planet reintegrated with the New Republic after Pellaeon's defeat during the [[Imperial Skirmishes]] in [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" />

The planet was attacked and occupied by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] during their initial assault on the Mid Rim. The planet remained under Vong control for most of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War|war]]. [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial forces]] later routed the alien invaders in the system after a failed Vong assault on Imperial space.<ref name="TEA" />

Orinda remained under Imperial control following the defeat of the Yuuzhan Vong.<ref name="TEA" />
